subject: Stanley Cup
hook: STANLEY CUP IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The NHL does not actually own the Stanley Cup; it is held by the league through an agreement with two Canadian trustees.
angle_support: the NHL does not actually own the trophy but uses it by agreement with the two Canadian trustees of the Cup.

the NHL has registered trademarks associated with the name and likeness of the Stanley Cup, although there has been dispute as to whether the league has the right to own trademarks associated with a trophy that it does not own.
title: Who Actually Owns the Stanley Cup?
description: The National Hockey League hands out the Stanley Cup every summer, but the organization does not legally own it. The historic prize remains under the care of two Canadian custodians who control its rights through a special arrangement. Here is the surprising legal reality behind hockey's ultimate trophy.
narration: STANLEY CUP IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture North America's oldest pro sports trophy as private property, founded, manufactured, and owned by the National Hockey League. Yet the league does not possess legal ownership of the prize. Lord Stanley ordered the silver bowl in 1892 to reward amateur clubs. Ever since, true authority over the hardware has always resided with a pair of Canadian trustees. The NHL merely presents it through a formal agreement, despite registering trademarks anyway. Hockey's greatest championship icon is technically on loan every single year.
